final: SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id FROM client AS c JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE (substr(c.birth_date, 1, 2) BETWEEN '83' AND '87' OR substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1983' AND '1987') AND lower(d.A3) = 'east bohemia' ORDER BY c.client_id
